args.sql:
SELECT matchidx, wunit, COUNT(*) as stops_per_race 
FROM pit_stops 
GROUP BY matchidx, wunit 
LIMIT 10;

WITH avg_stops AS (
    SELECT 
        matchidx,
        COUNT(*) as total_stops,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) as unique_cars,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS numeric) / COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) as avg_stops_per_car
    FROM pit_stops
    GROUP BY matchidx
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(avg_stops_per_car, 2) as avg_stops,
    CASE 
        WHEN avg_stops_per_car < 1.5 THEN 'Single-Stop Race'
        WHEN avg_stops_per_car >= 1.5 AND avg_stops_per_car <= 2.5 THEN 'Standard Two-Stop'
        ELSE 'High-Strategy Event'
    END as pit_strategy_cluster
FROM avg_stops
ORDER BY avg_stops;

    SELECT 
        matchidx,
        COUNT(*) as total_stops,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) as unique_cars,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS numeric) / COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) as avg_stops_per_car
    FROM pit_stops
    GROUP BY matchidx
)
SELECT 
    pit_strategy_cluster,
    COUNT(*) as race_count

    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN avg_stops_per_car < 1.5 THEN 'Single-Stop Race'
            WHEN avg_stops_per_car >= 1.5 AND avg_stops_per_car <= 2.5 THEN 'Standard Two-Stop'
            ELSE 'High-Strategy Event'
        END as pit_strategy_cluster
    FROM avg_stops
) classified
GROUP BY pit_strategy_cluster;
